Stack_Exp.Stack_Option_1_Info:
{WoG Rebalanced Stats}

Health, minimum and maximum damage, and speed use percentage growth. Attack and Defense use flat values.
Stack_Exp.Stack_Option_2_Info:
{WoG Rebalanced Abilities}

Each WoG creature belonging to a faction receives one targeted stack-experience ability. Its original additional ability lines are removed when this option is enabled.
Stack_Exp.Stack_Option_3_Info:
{WoG Include Neutrals}

WoG neutral creatures receive one targeted stack-experience ability each. Their original additional ability lines are removed when this option is enabled.
Stack_Exp.Stack_Option_4_Info:
{TUM Rebalanced Stats}

Health, minimum and maximum damage, and speed use percentage growth. Attack and Defense use flat values.
Stack_Exp.Stack_Option_5_Info:
{TUM Rebalanced Abilities}

TUM faction creatures receive a reduced, targeted selection of stack-experience abilities. Optional native CFG overrides are separate and cannot be controlled here; see the README.
Stack_Exp.Stack_Option_6_Info:
{TUM Include Neutrals}

Third Upgrade Mod neutral creatures receive one targeted stack-experience ability each. Their original additional ability lines are removed when this option is enabled.
